```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
library(ggrepel)

# ── Load & clean data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data <- read.csv("STAT_408_Final_proj_data.csv")

# Standardize column names
names(data) <- make.names(names(data))

# Type conversion
data$Sample_Size <- as.numeric(gsub(",", "", data$Sample_Size))
data$Data_Value  <- as.numeric(data$Data_Value)

# Blank → NA
data[data == ""] <- NA

# Remove flagged / suppressed estimates
df_clean <- data |> filter(is.na(Data_Value_Footnote))

# Drop unused metadata columns
df_clean <- df_clean[, -c(9, 10, 13, 14)]

# Remove rows with missing outcome
df_clean <- df_clean |> filter(!is.na(Data_Value))

# ── Subsets used across pages ────────────────────────────────────────────────
obesity_data <- df_clean |>
  filter(
    Question == "Percent of adults aged 18 years and older who have obesity",
    StratificationCategory1 == "Total"
  )

activity_data <- df_clean |>
  filter(
    Question == "Percent of adults who achieve at least 150 minutes a week of moderate-intensity aerobic physical activity or 75 minutes a week of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity (or an equivalent combination)",
    StratificationCategory1 == "Total"
  )

obesity_state <- obesity_data |>
  group_by(LocationDesc) |>
  summarize(avg_obesity = mean(Data_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

activity_state <- activity_data |>
  group_by(LocationDesc) |>
  summarize(avg_activity = mean(Data_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

combined <- inner_join(obesity_state, activity_state, by = "LocationDesc")

# ── Shared ggplot theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theme_dash <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 11),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title    = element_text(size = 11)
    )
}
```

      "Drop Unused Columns"
    ),

      "Stripped commas and coerced Sample_Size and Data_Value to numeric using as.numeric(gsub(\",\", \"\", ...))",
      "Replaced all empty string cells with NA for consistent missing-value handling across the dataset",
      "Dropped rows where Data_Value_Footnote was not NA — these are estimates the CDC marks as suppressed or statistically unreliable (e.g. small cell sizes)",
      "Removed any remaining rows with a missing Data_Value (obesity %) to ensure a fully observed outcome variable",
      "Removed Data_Value_Type, Data_Value_Unit, and two other metadata columns (cols 9, 10, 13, 14) not needed for analysis"
    ),
    `R Code` = c(
      'as.numeric(gsub(",", "", Sample_Size))',
      'data[data == ""] <- NA',

      'filter(!is.na(Data_Value))',
      'df_clean[, -c(9, 10, 13, 14)]'
    )
  ),

)

### Column {width="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Rows Removed at Each Stage"
removal_summary <- data.frame(
  Stage = c(
    "Raw data",
    "After flagged rows removed",
    "After missing Data_Value removed"
  ),
  Rows = c(
    nrow(data),
    nrow(data |> filter(is.na(Data_Value_Footnote))),
    nrow(df_clean)
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    Removed = Rows - lag(Rows, default = first(Rows)),
    Removed = ifelse(Removed == 0, "—", scales::comma(abs(Removed)))
  )

knitr::kable(
  removal_summary,
  col.names = c("Stage", "Rows Remaining", "Rows Removed"),
  format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
  align = c("l","r","r")
)
```

# Analysis {icon="bar-chart"}

## Row

### Column {.tabset width="60%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Obesity Rate by State"
obesity_state |>
  arrange(desc(avg_obesity)) |>
  mutate(LocationDesc = fct_reorder(LocationDesc, avg_obesity)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = LocationDesc, y = avg_obesity,
             fill = avg_obesity > mean(avg_obesity))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#B8CCE0", "#E8534A")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title   = "Average Obesity Rate by State",
    subtitle = "Red = above national average       Blue = below national average",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Avg Obesity (%)"
  ) +
  theme_dash()
```

```{r}
#| title: "Choropleth Map"
us_map <- map_data("state")

map_joined <- us_map |>
  left_join(
    obesity_state |> mutate(region = tolower(LocationDesc)),
    by = "region"
  )

ggplot(map_joined, aes(long, lat, group = group, fill = avg_obesity)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  coord_fixed(1.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "lightblue", high = "#E8534A",
    na.value = "grey85",
    name = "Obesity (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Average Obesity Rate by State",
    subtitle = "Lighter = lower prevalence  |  Darker red = higher prevalence"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm")
  )
```

```{r}
#| title: "Trend Over Time"
obesity_data |>
  group_by(YearStart) |>
  summarize(avg_obesity = mean(Data_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = YearStart, y = avg_obesity)) +
  geom_line(color = "#E8534A", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "#E8534A", size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(
    title    = "National Average Obesity Rate Over Time",
    subtitle = "Consistently rising year over year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Avg Obesity (%)"
  ) +
  theme_dash()
```

```{r}
#| title: "Activity vs. Obesity"
model    <- lm(avg_obesity ~ avg_activity, data = combined)
combined$residuals <- resid(model)
threshold <- quantile(abs(combined$residuals), 0.95)
outliers  <- combined |> filter(abs(residuals) >= threshold)

ggplot(combined, aes(x = avg_activity, y = avg_obesity)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "#1A2C5B", size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#E8534A", fill = "#E8534A", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_point(data = outliers, size = 3, color = "#0D7C8F") +
  geom_text_repel(data = outliers, aes(label = LocationDesc), size = 3, color = "#0D7C8F") +
  labs(
    title    = "Physical Activity vs. Obesity Rate by State",
    subtitle = "Teal labels = residual outliers  |  95% confidence band",
    x = "Physical Activity Rate (%)",
    y = "Obesity Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_dash()
```

```{r}
#| title: "Summary Statistics"
stats_df <- data.frame(
  Measure = c(
    "National avg obesity",
    "Lowest state",
    "Highest state",
    "National avg activity",
    "Lowest activity state",
    "Highest activity state",
    "Correlation (activity ~ obesity)"
  ),
  Value = c(
    paste0(round(mean(obesity_state$avg_obesity), 1), "%"),
    paste0(obesity_state$LocationDesc[which.min(obesity_state$avg_obesity)],
           " (", round(min(obesity_state$avg_obesity), 1), "%)"),
    paste0(obesity_state$LocationDesc[which.max(obesity_state$avg_obesity)],
           " (", round(max(obesity_state$avg_obesity), 1), "%)"),
    paste0(round(mean(activity_state$avg_activity), 1), "%"),
    paste0(activity_state$LocationDesc[which.min(activity_state$avg_activity)],
           " (", round(min(activity_state$avg_activity), 1), "%)"),
    paste0(activity_state$LocationDesc[which.max(activity_state$avg_activity)],
           " (", round(max(activity_state$avg_activity), 1), "%)"),
    round(cor(combined$avg_activity, combined$avg_obesity), 2)
  )
)

knitr::kable(stats_df, col.names = c("Measure", "Value"), align = c("l","r"))
```

## Row {height="80%"}

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Obesity by Income Level"
income_data <- df_clean |>
  filter(
    Question == "Percent of adults aged 18 years and older who have obesity",
    StratificationCategory1 == "Income"
  ) |>
  group_by(Stratification1) |>
  summarize(avg_obesity = mean(Data_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(!is.na(Stratification1)) |>
  mutate(Stratification1 = factor(Stratification1, levels = c(
    "Less than $15,000", "$15,000 - $24,999", "$25,000 - $34,999",
    "$35,000 - $49,999", "$50,000 - $74,999", "$75,000 or greater"
  )))

ggplot(income_data, aes(x = Stratification1, y = avg_obesity, fill = avg_obesity)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#B8CCE0", high = "#E8534A") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 12)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Average Obesity Rate by Income Level",
    subtitle = "Lower income → higher obesity prevalence",
    x = "Income Bracket",
    y = "Avg Obesity (%)"
  ) +
  theme_dash()
```
